This memorial roundup honors notable entertainers and cultural figures who died in 2026, highlighting their defining roles and achievements.
 The list remembers Hayden Panettiere for Heroes and Scream, Catherine O’Hara for Home Alone and Schitt’s Creek, and Chuck Norris for his martial-arts career and Walker, Texas Ranger. [...] In 2026, several celebrities—actors, directors, reality stars, and more—passed away. Most recently, former Heroes and Scream star Hayden Panettiere was found dead in her South Carolina home at 36. We’ve also had to say goodbye to Hollywood legends like Catherine O’Hara, action star Chuck Norris, Dawson’s Creek’s James Van Der Beek, as well as TV producer Ted Turner.
